new_page.description: Queensborough, New Westminster houses for sale: listings, sales and sales ratio for October 2026. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®.
new_page.h1: Queensborough Houses for Sale | New Westminster Real Estate

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Queensborough. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Queensborough, New Westminster: 39 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 1 of 14 New Westminster communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Queensborough rose from 28 in June to 39 in October (+39.3%), and 10 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 25.8% of New Westminster’s 151 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Queensborough?
Queensborough also had 71 condos and townhomes listed and 7 sold in October, against 39 houses listed. The Queensborough condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Queensborough home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

22 houses sold in Queensborough with a median price of $1,264,500 (the middle half sold between $1,068,750 and $1,354,750), taking a median of 22 days to sell at 95.8% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $596 per square foot, a median year built of 1994 and a median lot of 5,771 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Queensborough?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 39 houses listed in Queensborough. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Queensborough a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Queensborough had a sales ratio of 5%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Queensborough from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in Queensborough over those 5 months, out of 75 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Queensborough?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Queensborough sell for?
faq.a: 22 houses sold in Queensborough between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,264,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Queensborough?
faq.a: The median was 22 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.8% of the last list price (0% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
